setup: You are given $\sinh x = [[opp]]/[[adj]]$ and asked for $\cosh x$.

steps.say: The basic hyperbolic identity is $\cosh^{2} x - \sinh^{2} x = 1$, so the square of the hyperbolic cosine is one more than the square of the given value.
With $\sinh x = [[opp]]/[[adj]]$ and hypotenuse [[hyp]], the square root of one plus $[[opp]]^{2}/[[adj]]^{2}$ is $[[hyp]]/[[adj]]$, which is [[answer]].
